text.p: Shanghai Narcissus Electric Appliances Industry Co on Tuesday posted a net loss of 1.56 million yuan for 1996, against 22.61 million yuan profit in 1995, under international accounting standards.

Fierce market competition for washing machine sales, the firm's pillar product, was the main reason for the poor results, the company said in its annual report published in the Shanghai Securities News. It gave no further details.

Under domestic accounting standards, the company posted net profit of 7.554 million yuan in 1996 against 26.538 million yuan in 1995, the report said. Earnings per share plunged to 0.032 yuan from 0.123 yuan, it said.

The major difference was that international accountants deleted from the domestically-audited profit 6.48 million yuan for bad debt reserves and 2.9 million yuan for possible losses of unsold, warehoused goods.
The company's board of directors proposed no returns to shareholders for the 1996 fiscal year, pending the approval of shareholders at a meeting scheduled for May 30.
